entities.name: UE-initiated de-registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE to de-register from the network.

entities.name: DEREGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to initiate de-registration.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: State in which the UE is registered with the network.

entities.name: De-registration type condition
entities.description: Condition based on the de-registration type specified in the DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message.

relations.description: The procedure includes sending the DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message.
The procedure requires the UE to be in 5GMM-REGISTERED state.
The message includes a de-registration type that determines the procedure behavior.
